name: Gutters
description: Beak things, fast and long-necked predators that eat their prey alive, also called gutters. They nest across Gut in great numbers, and also in the Crater, the Bonefields and the Cannibal Plains. The hermit No-Face, wanted by the United Cities, lives among them in Gut, alone at a camp on a small island, and shoots anyone who comes ashore.
